definition.description: Wait for an event to be triggered.

inputs.name: EventName
inputs.description: The name of the event to listen for.

definition.description: Create a new workflow instance of the specified workflow and execute it.

inputs.name: WorkflowDefinitionId
inputs.description: The definition ID of the workflow to execute.

inputs.name: CorrelationId
inputs.description: The correlation ID to associate the workflow with.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: The input to send to the workflow.

inputs.name: WaitForCompletion
inputs.description: Wait for the child workflow to complete before completing this activity.

definition.description: Publishes an event.

inputs.name: EventName
inputs.description: The name of the event to publish.

inputs.name: CorrelationId
inputs.description: The correlation ID to scope the event to.

inputs.name: IsLocalEvent
inputs.description: Whether the event is local to the workflow. When checked, the event will be delivered to this workflow instance only.

inputs.name: Payload
inputs.description: The payload to send as the event body.

definition.description: Requests a given task to be run.

inputs.name: TaskName
inputs.description: The name of the task being requested.

inputs.name: Payload
inputs.description: Any additional parameters to send to the task.

outputs.name: TaskId
outputs.description: The ID of the task that was requested to run.

definition.description: Create a new workflow instance of the specified workflow and dispatch it for execution.

inputs.name: WorkflowDefinitionId
inputs.description: The definition ID of the workflow to dispatch.

inputs.name: CorrelationId
inputs.description: The correlation ID to associate the workflow with.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: The input to send to the workflow.

inputs.name: WaitForCompletion
inputs.description: Wait for the child workflow to complete before completing this activity.

inputs.name: StartNewTrace
inputs.description: Start a new trace context when using Open Telemetry.

inputs.name: ChannelName
inputs.description: The channel to dispatch the workflow to.

definition.description: Create new workflow instances for each item in the data source and dispatch them for execution.

inputs.name: WorkflowDefinitionId
inputs.description: The definition ID of the workflows to dispatch.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.description: The data source to use for dispatching the workflows.

inputs.name: DefaultItemInputKey
inputs.description: The default key to use for the input name when sending the current item to the dispatched workflow. Will not be used if the Items field contains a list of dictionaries.

inputs.name: CorrelationIdFunction
inputs.description: A function to compute the correlation ID to associate a dispatched workflow with.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Additional input to send to the workflows being dispatched.

inputs.name: WaitForCompletion
inputs.description: Wait for the dispatched workflows to complete before completing this activity.

inputs.name: StartNewTrace
inputs.description: Start a new trace context when using Open Telemetry.

inputs.name: ChannelName
inputs.description: The channel to dispatch the workflow to.

definition.description: Assigns a given value to a container's output.

inputs.name: OutputName
inputs.description: The output to assign.

inputs.name: OutputValue
inputs.description: The value to assign.

definition.description: Write a line of text to the console.

inputs.name: Text
inputs.description: The text to write.

definition.description: Assign a value to a workflow variable.

inputs.name: Variable
inputs.description: The variable to assign the value to.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: The value to assign.

definition.description: A milestone activity that marks the start of a flowchart.
Evaluate a set of case conditions and schedule the activity for a matching case.

inputs.name: Cases
inputs.description: The cases to evaluate.

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.description: The switch mode determines whether the first match should be scheduled, or all matches.

definition.description: Execute an activity while a given condition evaluates to true.

inputs.name: Condition
inputs.description: The condition to evaluate.

definition.description: A workflow is an activity that executes its Root activity.
Execute a set of activities in sequence.
Set the name of the workflow instance to a specified value.
Iterate over a sequence of steps between a start and an end number.

inputs.name: Start
inputs.description: The start step.

inputs.name: End
inputs.description: The end step.

inputs.name: Step
inputs.description: The step size. To count down, enter a negative number.

inputs.name: OuterBoundInclusive
inputs.description: Controls whether the end step is upper/lowerbound inclusive or exclusive. True (inclusive) by default.

outputs.name: CurrentValue
outputs.description: The current value of the iteration.

definition.description: Iterate over a set of values.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.description: The set of values to iterate.

outputs.name: CurrentValue
outputs.description: The current value of the iteration.

definition.description: Branch execution into multiple branches.

inputs.name: JoinMode
inputs.description: Controls when this activity yields control back to its parent activity.

definition.description: Evaluate a Boolean condition to determine which activity to execute next.
Execute inline code provided to the activity.
A placeholder activity that will be used in case a workflow definition references an activity type that cannot be found.
Execute a set of activities in parallel.
Schedule an activity for each item in parallel.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.description: The items to iterate through.

definition.description: Read a line of text from the console.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: The line read from the console.

definition.description: A flowchart is a collection of activities and connections between them.
Explicitly merge multiple branches into a single branch of execution.

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.description: The join mode determines whether this activity should continue as soon as one inbound path comes in (WaitAny), or once all inbound paths have executed (WaitAll). To wait for all activated inbound paths, set the mode to WaitAllActive.

definition.description: A simple container that executes the specified activity.
Evaluate a set of case conditions and schedule the activity for a matching case.

inputs.name: Cases
inputs.description: The set of cases to evaluate.

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.description: The switch mode determines whether the first match should be scheduled, or all matches.

definition.description: Branch execution into multiple branches that will be executed in parallel.

inputs.name: Branches
inputs.description: A list of expected outcomes to handle.

definition.description: Evaluate a Boolean condition to determine which path to execute next.
Mark the workflow as finished.
Marks the end of a flowchart, causing the flowchart to complete.
Faults the workflow.

inputs.name: Code
inputs.description: Code to categorize the fault.

inputs.name: Category
inputs.description: Category to categorize the fault. Examples: HTTP, Alteration, Azure, etc.

inputs.name: FaultType
inputs.description: The type of fault. Examples: System, Business, Integration, etc.

inputs.name: Message
inputs.description: The message to include with the fault.

definition.description: Break out of a loop.
Signals the current composite activity to complete itself as a whole.

inputs.name: Outcomes
inputs.description: The outcome or set of outcomes to complete this activity with.

definition.description: Set the CorrelationId of the workflow to a given value.

inputs.name: CorrelationId
inputs.description: An expression that evaluates to the value to store as the correlation id.

definition.description: Trigger workflow execution at a specific interval.

inputs.name: Interval
inputs.description: The interval at which the timer should execute.

definition.description: Trigger execution at a specific time in the future.

inputs.name: DateTime
inputs.description: The future point in time to trigger workflow execution.

definition.description: Trigger workflow execution at a specific interval using a CRON expression.

inputs.name: CronExpression
inputs.description: The CRON expression at which the timer should execute.

definition.description: Delay execution for the specified amount of time.

inputs.name: TimeSpan
inputs.description: The timespan to delay workflow execution.

definition.description: Send one or more files (zipped) to the HTTP response.

inputs.name: ContentType
inputs.description: The content type of the file to serve. Leave empty to let the system determine the content type.

inputs.name: Filename
inputs.description: The name of the file to serve. Leave empty to let the system determine the file name.

inputs.name: EntityTag
inputs.description: The Entity Tag of the file to serve. Leave empty to let the system determine the Entity Tag.

inputs.name: Content
inputs.description: The file content to serve. Supports various types, such as byte array, stream, string, Uri, Downloadable and a (mixed) array of the aforementioned types.

inputs.name: EnableResumableDownloads
inputs.description: Whether to enable resumable downloads. When enabled, the client can resume a download if the connection is lost.

inputs.name: DownloadCorrelationId
inputs.description: The correlation ID of the download used to resume a download. If left empty, the x-download-id header will be used.

definition.description: Write a response to the current HTTP response object.

inputs.name: StatusCode
inputs.description: The status code to return.

inputs.name: Content
inputs.description: The content to write back. String values will be sent as-is, while objects will be serialized to a JSON string. Byte arrays and streams will be sent as files.

inputs.name: ContentType
inputs.description: The content type to write when sending the response.

inputs.name: ResponseHeaders
inputs.description: The headers to send along with the response.

definition.description: Send an HTTP request.

inputs.name: ExpectedStatusCodes
inputs.description: A list of expected status codes to handle and the corresponding activity to execute when the status code matches.

definition.description: Wait for an inbound HTTP request that matches the specified path and methods.

inputs.name: Path
inputs.description: The path to associate with the workflow.

inputs.name: SupportedMethods
inputs.description: The HTTP methods to accept.

inputs.name: Authorize
inputs.description: Allow authenticated requests only.

inputs.name: Policy
inputs.description: Provide a policy to evaluate. If the policy fails, the request is forbidden.

inputs.name: RequestTimeout
inputs.description: The maximum time allowed to process the request.

inputs.name: RequestSizeLimit
inputs.description: The maximum request size allowed in bytes.

inputs.name: FileSizeLimit
inputs.description: The maximum file size allowed in bytes for an individual file.

inputs.name: AllowedFileExtensions
inputs.description: Only file extensions in this list are allowed. Leave empty to allow all extensions.

inputs.name: BlockedFileExtensions
inputs.description: File extensions in this list are forbidden. Leave empty to not block any extension.

inputs.name: AllowedMimeTypes
inputs.description: Only MIME types in this list are allowed. Leave empty to allow all types.

outputs.name: ParsedContent
outputs.description: The parsed request content, if any.

outputs.name: File
outputs.description: The first uploaded file, if any.

outputs.name: RouteData
outputs.description: The parsed route data, if any.

definition.description: Downloads a file from a given URL.

inputs.name: Url
inputs.description: The URL to download the file from.

inputs.name: Method
inputs.description: The HTTP method to use when sending the request.

inputs.name: ExpectedStatusCodes
inputs.description: A list of expected status codes to handle.

inputs.name: RequestContent
inputs.description: The content to send with the request. Can be a string, an object, a byte array or a stream.

inputs.name: RequestContentType
inputs.description: The content type to use when sending the request.

inputs.name: Authorization
inputs.description: The Authorization header value to send with the request. For example: Bearer {some-access-token}.

inputs.name: DisableAuthorizationHeaderValidation
inputs.description: A value that allows to add the Authorization header without validation.

inputs.name: RequestHeaders
inputs.description: The headers to send along with the request.

outputs.name: ResponseContentStream
outputs.description: The downloaded content stream, if any.

outputs.name: ResponseContentBytes
outputs.description: The downloaded content bytes, if any.

outputs.name: ResponseHeaders
outputs.description: The response headers that were received.

outputs.name: ResponseContentHeaders
outputs.description: The response content headers that were received.

definition.description: Send an HTTP request with flow-style outcomes per expected status code.

inputs.name: ExpectedStatusCodes
inputs.description: A list of expected status codes to handle.

definition.description: Executes Python code.

inputs.name: Script
inputs.description: The script to run.

inputs.name: PossibleOutcomes
inputs.description: A list of possible outcomes. Use "SetOutcome(string)" to set the outcome. Use "SetOutcomes(params string[])" to set multiple outcomes.

definition.description: Executes JavaScript code.

inputs.name: Script
inputs.description: The script to run.

inputs.name: PossibleOutcomes
inputs.description: A list of possible outcomes. Use "setOutcome()" to set the outcome. Use "setOutcomes()" to set multiple outcomes.

definition.description: Executes C# code.

inputs.name: Script
inputs.description: The script to run.

inputs.name: PossibleOutcomes
inputs.description: A list of possible outcomes. Use "SetOutcome(string)" to set the outcome. Use "SetOutcomes(params string[])" to set multiple outcomes.

inputs.name: PlanId
inputs.description: The ID of the alteration plan.

inputs.name: PlanId
inputs.description: The ID of the alteration plan.

definition.description: Dispatches jobs for the specified Alteration Plan.

inputs.name: PlanId
inputs.description: The ID of the alteration plan.

definition.description: Generates jobs for the specified Alteration Plan.
